description: PMH-6010 HDPE Semi Transparent Pre-applied Membrane composites a HDPE film, pressure sensitive adhesive, protective coating and release liner. For 1.2m width membrane, one long edge has a reserved 80mm wide self-adhesive overlap as cold apply. For 2.4m width membrane, both long edge have 150mm wide welding strip, used for tunnel with large deformation or rough surface lining.
whereToUse: PMH-6010 is designed for dim light, wet, dusty and vibration construction condition
suitable for various tunnels and underground space waterproofing projects
highway, railway, power, hydraulic, subway section tunnels and caverns
used for tunnel with large deformation or rough surface lining
advantages: Fully adhered to post-cast concrete, no water migration, significantly enhances the reliability of the waterproofing system
Lightweight and transparent material, the overlapping areas are more suitable for welding construction, convenient and efficient
Excellent durability, resistant to chemical corrosion, can achieve the same design life as the structure
Environmentally friendly, free from harmful chemicals, no pollution to water and soil
notFor: The laying of materials is strictly prohibited during rainy or snowy weather, or in winds of level 5 or higher

The environment temperature for cold application of self-adhesive membranes and tapes should not be lower than 5°C (this includes storage, construction, and the 24 hours following the completion of construction)
It is strictly forbidden for personnel wearing studded shoes to enter the construction site
The waterproof layer should not be damaged when pouring structural concrete, which should be completed within 15 days after the installation of the membranes
Contractors must undergo training before starting work

technicalData.label: Resistance to tearing, nail shank (BS EN 12310-1:2000)
Resistance to impact, hard support (BS EN 12691:2018 A)
Resistance to impact, soft support (BS EN 12691:2018 B)
Resistance to static loading, hard support (BS EN 12730:2015 B)
Watertightness, after saturated lime 28 days (BS EN 1928:2000)
Foldability at low temperature (BS EN 495-5:2013)
technicalData.value: No Visible Crack or Fracture at Folded Area

technicalData.label: Storage period
technicalData.value: one year from the production date

mixing: When laying waterproofing membranes, sufficient loose laying allowance should be left based on the smoothness of the substrate.
storage: Avoid exposure to sunlight and rain. If necessary, cover with felt cloth. Ensure proper ventilation, and the storage temperature should not exceed 45°C.
